newsitem.title: UK: UK shares recover as rate hopes lift Europe.
newsitem.headline: UK shares recover as rate hopes lift Europe.

text.p: Rising continental markets and strong gilts dragged UK shares off their lows late in the session on Thursday, after a day dogged by weakness in drug stocks and lacking the usual Wall Street stimulus.

The FTSE 100 index closed up 1.0 point at 4,050.2, with gainers nearly matching decliners 45 to 48. The index was stuck in a narrow range for much of the session, as New York took its annual Thanksgiving break.
Traders said the market was likely to be marooned near its current levels with Wall Street unlikely to see much action in tomorrow's post-holiday session.
